statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
The patient has had recent episodes of transient cerebral ischemia
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with rhythm disturbances
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources of transient ischemic attacks
The diagnoses supporting the service are G45.9, I49.5, and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
